$comment: A testimonial's stored fields, by the founder's rulings of 18/11/2026 on the ID-3944 field names. The person is name, not author, so it does not clash with a post's author. The quote card draws the photo only, with no fallback to a logo; the company logo and the service a testimonial is about are dropped until something draws them. Testimonials have no topics (contract/sections.json) and no page of their own.
